## Descriptive Statistics for each sector
```{r}

library(moments)

sectors <- c("NIFTY_BANK", "NIFTY_IT", "NIFTY_AUTO",
             "NIFTY_FMCG", "NIFTY_pharma", "NIFTY_REALTY")

desc_stats <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sectors, function(s) {
  r <- data[[s]]$Return
  data.frame(
    Sector   = s,
    Mean     = round(mean(r, na.rm=TRUE), 6),
    Std_Dev  = round(sd(r, na.rm=TRUE), 6),
    Min      = round(min(r, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
    Max      = round(max(r, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
    Skewness = round(skewness(r, na.rm=TRUE), 4),
    Kurtosis = round(kurtosis(r, na.rm=TRUE), 4)
  )
}))

print(desc_stats)
```

## Stationality test

```{r}
library(tseries)

adf_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sectors, function(s) {
  r <- na.omit(data[[s]]$Return)  # Remove NAs here
  adf <- adf.test(r)
  data.frame(
    Sector     = s,
    ADF_Stat   = round(adf$statistic, 4),
    p_value    = round(adf$p.value, 4),
    Stationary = ifelse(adf$p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
  )
}))

print(adf_results)
```

## Correlation Matrix

```{r}
# Build correlation matrix safely using joins
return_wide <- data[[sectors[1]]] %>%
  select(Date, Return) %>%
  rename(!!sectors[1] := Return)

for(s in sectors[-1]) {
  return_wide <- return_wide %>%
    left_join(
      data[[s]] %>% select(Date, Return) %>% rename(!!s := Return),
      by = "Date"
    )
}

# Remove rows with any NA
return_wide_clean <- return_wide %>%
  select(-Date) %>%
  na.omit()

# Correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(return_wide_clean)

# Clean sector names for display
colnames(cor_matrix) <- rownames(cor_matrix) <- c(
  "Banking", "IT", "Auto", "FMCG", "Pharma", "Realty"
)

print(round(cor_matrix, 3))
```
```{r}
library(tseries)

jb_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sectors, function(s) {
  r <- na.omit(data[[s]]$Return)
  jb <- jarque.bera.test(r)
  data.frame(
    Sector   = s,
    JB_Stat  = round(jb$statistic, 2),
    p_value  = round(jb$p.value, 4),
    Normal   = ifelse(jb$p.value > 0.05, "Yes", "No")
  )
}))

jb_results$Sector <- recode(jb_results$Sector,
  "NIFTY_BANK"   = "Banking",
  "NIFTY_IT"     = "IT",
  "NIFTY_AUTO"   = "Auto",
  "NIFTY_FMCG"   = "FMCG",
  "NIFTY_pharma" = "Pharma",
  "NIFTY_REALTY" = "Realty"
)

print(jb_results)
```

## Plots

### Boxplot of Returns

```{r}

all_returns <- bind_rows(lapply(sectors, function(s) {
  data[[s]] %>%
    select(Date, Return) %>%
    mutate(Sector = recode(s,
      "NIFTY_BANK"   = "Banking",
      "NIFTY_IT"     = "IT",
      "NIFTY_AUTO"   = "Auto",
      "NIFTY_FMCG"   = "FMCG",
      "NIFTY_pharma" = "Pharma",
      "NIFTY_REALTY" = "Realty"
    ))
}))
ggplot(all_returns, aes(x = reorder(Sector, Return, FUN = sd), 
                         y = Return, fill = Sector)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0.4, width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Daily Returns by Sector",
       x = "Sector", y = "Daily Log Return",
       caption = "Source: NSE India | 2011–2026") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```


### RBI Policy Timeline

```{r}
repo_clean$Date <- as.Date(repo_clean$Date)

repo_clean %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(Change > 0, "Rate Hike", "Rate Cut")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = Change, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 60, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rate Hike" = "#E63946", 
                                "Rate Cut"  = "#2ecc71")) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  labs(title = "RBI Repo Rate Changes (2011–202)",
       x = "Year", y = "Change in Repo Rate (%)",
       fill = "Direction",
       caption = "Source: Reserve Bank of India") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Correlation Heatmap

```{r}
library(reshape2)

cor_melted <- melt(cor_matrix)

ggplot(cor_melted, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 2)), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2196F3", mid = "white", 
                        high = "#E63946",
                        midpoint = 0.5,
                        limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Correlation Matrix of Sectoral Returns",
       x = "", y = "", fill = "Correlation",
       caption = "Source: NSE India | 2011–2026") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
